record.body:
## Description

R5/R6: Detect claim id from acceptance payload.claim/claim_id when set, else subject. Refuse with CloseRefused when aff binary is missing. Add unit test that done succeeds when mocked verdict and recheck both exit 0.

## Approach

Update _enforce_claim_gates / _run_aff_claim_gate in close_batch.py. Extend frozen tests via parent oracle amendment for the success-path test and any helper needed for claim_id payload.

payload.title: Harden claim gate id detection and missing aff

record.subject: fix-claim-gate-hardening
